script_text: Stop, Aries: your fire element got a cosmic money invoice. A parent or roommate could name the number that changes your budget. For career and cash, your 10th House of reputation rises through a 2nd House opening: price your skill higher, and a client may accept a premium package. Avoid signing anything from guilt or urgency before midnight. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
